what_is_it.explanation: HFlow is an open-source SDK designed to help robotics and physical AI teams manage their multimodal data pipelines. It guides human and robot data through a four-stage lifecycle: collection, ingestion, curation, and delivery, using standard file formats like MCAP and Parquet. Existing transformation and quality control code plugs directly into the pipeline through small adapters without requiring a complete rewrite.
